published.title: The Death of Ezekiel's Wife
published.summary: The LORD tells Ezekiel that the desire of his eyes will be taken away and commands him not to perform the usual mourning rites. His wife dies that evening; he explains his conduct to the people as a sign concerning the sanctuary and their families.

published.title: Ezekiel Is Shown the Temple in a Vision
published.summary: In a vision Ezekiel is brought to the land of Israel and set on a high mountain. He sees a man with a measuring reed at a gate and is told to observe what he is shown and declare it to the house of Israel.
